scope: Offline synthetic fixtures; no target selected and no runtime evidence.

checks.name: helper_commands
checks.detail: Scaffold, selected-file validation and package commands exited 0 without stderr.

checks.name: release_selection
checks.detail: Explicit release manifest selects only the four native app files; manifest and evidence are excluded from the archive.

checks.name: app_file_set
checks.detail: App source contains exactly the selected files and the release manifest.

checks.name: regular_files
checks.detail: Selected files are regular files with no linked path components.

checks.name: utf8
checks.detail: All selected files round-trip as UTF-8.

checks.name: app_conf_identity
checks.detail: All app.conf sections and values exactly match fixture metadata and the native home-view scaffold, including disabled state and both version stanzas.

checks.name: navigation
checks.detail: Navigation selects the packaged home view; search_view refers to the platform search view.

checks.name: simple_xml_shape
checks.detail: One Simple XML 1.1 dashboard with one row, one panel, one table and one inline search; no extra tokens or searches.

checks.name: xml_value_equality
checks.detail: Parsed XML label, title, query, earliest and latest equal JSON-decoded fixture strings, character for character.

checks.name: xml_escaping
checks.detail: Ampersands and angle brackets are escaped as XML text; U+00C5 is UTF-8; no DTD/entity declarations.

checks.name: metadata_roles
checks.detail: Global metadata ACL exactly preserves bench_reader read and bench_editor write roles, with export = none and no wildcard or additional grants.

checks.name: package_receipt_digest
checks.detail: Independently recomputed package SHA-256 and byte length match the packaging receipt.

checks.name: archive_membership
checks.detail: Archive contains one bench_delta root and exactly four regular selected files; no links, duplicate names or extra content.

checks.name: archive_path_safety
checks.detail: All archive member names are relative and free of path traversal.

checks.name: archive_bytes
checks.detail: Every archive file is byte-identical to its selected source file; archive inspected without extracting.

checks.name: normalized_archive_metadata
checks.detail: Tar timestamps/ownership are normalized; root mode 0755 and file modes 0644; gzip timestamp is zero with no stored filename.

checks.name: source_preservation
checks.detail: AGENTS.md, TASK.md and all supplied input/candidate files retain their pre-build SHA-256 values.

checks.name: digest_sidecar
checks.detail: SHA-256 sidecar names the exact package and contains its recomputed digest.

unresolved_inputs: Target role existence and effective permissions
